[SWS_CM_00211] Mapping of ara::com::e2e::TransportFaultCondition for Proxy Events
⌈
ara::com::e2e::TransportFaultConditionHandler
configured
via
Event::SetTransportFaultConditionHandler()
shall
report
one
of
the
following values for each transport error detected:
• TransportFaultCondition::kSampleRejected
if
the
underlying
DataReader entity has signaled SAMPLE_REJECTED (e.g.
due to corrup-
tion or lack of storage resources)
• TransportFaultCondition::kDeadlineMissed
if
the
underlying
DataReader has signaled REQUESTED_DEADLINE_MISSED (e.g.
due to
one or more missed timing deadlines)
• TransportFaultCondition::kSampleLost if the underlying DataReader
has signaled SAMPLE_LOST (e.g. because one or more samples have been de-
tected to be lost)
⌋
